builds.name: Cannon Barrage ceiling
builds.summary: AP Cannon Barrage has 12*(100+.1 AP), Fire at Will adds six waves, Deaths Daughter adds 300+.3 AP true damage. This tests the AP ultimate alternative.
builds.goal: AP Cannon Barrage has 12*(100+.1 AP), Fire at Will adds six waves, Deaths Daughter adds 300+.3 AP true damage. This tests the AP ultimate alternative.
builds.hypothesis:
Gangplank signals his ship to fire [12] waves of cannonballs anywhere on the map over [8] seconds. Each wave Slows by [30]% for [0.5] seconds and deals [40 / 70 / 100 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage. Maximum damage: [(40 / 70 / 100 + (0.1) × AP) × (12)]

This Ability can be upgraded in the shop via {{Spell_GangplankQWrapper_Name}}.

Fire at Will: Fires 6 additional waves of cannonballs.
Death's Daughter: Fires a Mega-Cannonball that deals [120 / 210 / 300 + (0.3) × AP] true damage and Slows by [75]% for [1] second.
Raise Morale: Allies inside Cannon Barrage gain [40]% Move Speed for [2] seconds.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

Purchase both damage upgrades, hold target in all waves for 8s; log true cannonball separately from magic waves/burns. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Use current stored source values and verify all conditional multipliers. Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs. Report observed damage only while the target survives; any theoretical full-window overkill is a separate raw-potential metric, not damage actually dealt.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Shadowflame, Riftmaker, Liandry's Torment, Blackfire Torch. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

builds.name: Powder Keg: one critical barrel explosion
builds.summary: Investigate high one legally triggered Powder Keg explosion output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one legally triggered Powder Keg explosion output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: A keg transfers its triggering attack damage, ignores 40% enemy armor and adds 155 physical damage against champions at rank 5. Critical inheritance, any barrel-specific crit rule and transfer of Q/Spellblade need explicit current-client checks. The inherited armor ignore must be combined with item penetration in the correct order, not added as a flat percentage sum.

kitEvidence.formula:
Gangplank places a powder keg that can be attacked by Gangplank and enemy champions for [25] seconds. When an enemy destroys it, the keg is defused. When Gangplank destroys it, it explodes, Slowing by [40 / 50 / 60 / 70 / 80]% for [2] seconds and dealing the Attack's damage, ignoring [40]% Armor. Champions take an additional [75 / 95 / 115 / 135 / 155] physical damage.

Keg health decays every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=2, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -1.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -0.5, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds. Keg explosions detonate other kegs with overlapping blast zones, but don't deal damage to the same target more than once. Keg explosions triggered by {{Spell_GangplankQWrapper_Name}} will grant the bonus gold for targets killed.
